_comment: Triaged security findings that do not block the build.
Every entry must carry a reason and a review_by date. scripts/security_scan.py
FAILS once an entry is past its review date, so an accepted risk cannot be
quietly forgotten. Removing the underlying advisory is always preferred to
Rationale for each entry is documented in docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md section 5.

pip-audit.reason: No fixed release published upstream. Transitive via python-jose[cryptography]. The advisory concerns side-channel resistance of pure-Python ECDSA; ICAP signs with HS256 (HMAC), so no ECDSA signing path is reached.
Blocked upstream: python-jose 3.4.0 and pyasn1-modules 0.2.8 both pin pyasn1<0.5.0, and the fix is 0.6.4. Used for ASN.1 parsing on the RSA/ECDSA paths, which HS256 does not exercise.

Upgraded 0.38.6 -> 0.47.2 (the highest version FastAPI 0.116.1 permits). Fully clearing these needs starlette 1.3.1, which changes route.path_format and breaks route-template metrics keying and the API inventory - verified: 9 tests fail. Tracked as a planned framework migration.

npm-audit.reason: Transitive of firebase 10.x with no non-breaking fix; clearing it needs a firebase major upgrade, which touches push notification delivery. undici is a Node HTTP client and is not exercised by the browser bundle.
